subject.title: fix(channels): defensively handle non-string prompter.text() results in token replace flow

question: Should malformed required setup prompt results reject/re-prompt, or may this PR intentionally treat them as empty keep/skip outcomes?
rationale: This is a public setup and credential behavior choice: the current patch avoids a crash but can keep stale credentials or skip required values, while the stricter path preserves required-input validation.

options.title: Preserve Required Validation
options.body: Repair this branch or use the stricter replacement so malformed required token/text results reject or retry instead of becoming keep/skip outcomes.

options.title: Accept Empty Fallback
options.body: Merge only if maintainers explicitly accept that malformed required prompt results can keep an existing credential or skip a required setup write.

options.title: Wait For Replacement
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90284 is made conflict-free and accepted as the canonical fix.

recommendation.title: Preserve Required Validation
recommendation.body: Repair this branch or use the stricter replacement so malformed required token/text results reject or retry instead of becoming keep/skip outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected setup wizard behavior and current implementation history are concentrated in his setup-flow commits.
